official_documentation.reviewed_scope: Official browser/device login flow, prerequisite account authentication and credential-storage guidance. Device-code authentication is documented as beta; no account settings or credential-copy fallback was used.

browser_observation.surface: Existing connected Chrome session; an unused existing tab was used.
browser_observation.observed_requirement: OpenAI presented a registered passkey/security-key challenge. Its normal alternative offered a recovery key.
browser_observation.cleanup: Browser policy rejected restoration to the internal new-tab URL. No workaround was attempted; the tab was left on the allowed official HTTPS authentication documentation page.

conclusion: The observed browser login cannot be completed unattended without the required account verification. This is a bounded observed requirement, not a claim of an API outage or universal impossibility.
decision: Keep native global-instruction rejection and the public model-launch refusal. Continue independent integration and skill work; no credential export, auth-setting change or verification bypass.
